functional_requirements.description: Calculate net settlement amount and itemized fee breakdown for each synthetic payment transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a gross transaction amount and merchant tier, return exact fee and net settlement
Sum of net settlement and fee equals gross amount to 2 decimal places

functional_requirements.description: Generate daily reconciliation summary grouping transactions by settlement status and flagging discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: All settled transactions are aggregated by date
Mismatched settlement totals are flagged with discrepancy code

architecture_decisions.title: Use Decimal Arithmetic for Fee and Settlement Calculations
architecture_decisions.decision: Represent all currency calculations using fixed-point Decimal arithmetic with explicit HALF_UP rounding.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Prevents floating-point representation drift during multi-transaction reconciliation.
